conditions.runtime: The client has both the JEM Handbook and the installed FTB Quests 2001.4.22 interface.

change.summary: Expose FTB Quests from the Handbook ribbon and keep authored quest backgrounds covering the complete visible viewport.

modifiers.before: The Handbook ribbon had no direct route to the native FTB Quests screen.
modifiers.after: A Quests ribbon opens ClientQuestFile.openGui and leaves quest state, rewards and navigation owned by FTB Quests.

modifiers.before: Minimum zoom fitted the entire background inside the viewport, exposing pixels outside it when aspect ratios differed.
modifiers.after: Minimum zoom uses cover geometry and clamps the camera to exact authored bounds, so no visible content pixel can leave the background.

cause.owner: JEMAchievementGuide native navigation and FTB presentation adapter

rationale.purpose: Make the quest book reachable from the guide without replacing FTB Quests and prevent the authored board from revealing an unpainted exterior.
rationale.decision_source: User requested the Handbook quest tab and a strict background edge. Codex retained the installed native FTB entry point and corrected the existing camera math.

introduced.summary: Add native FTB Quests navigation and strict authored-background cover geometry.

history.summary: Open the installed quest screen from the Handbook and replace fit zoom with cover zoom plus exact camera clamps.

relations: authored background bounds -> minimum zoom and camera clamp
notes: The extension does not duplicate quest progression, rewards, chapter selection or native FTB state.
unresolved: Runtime visual acceptance remains pending until the user opens the updated client.
